items.title: 32.4 Challenges in Treating Viral Infections (viral infections ke ilaaj ki mushkilat) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 32.4 with Quick Check 32.1 answered, printed page 233 (PDF 236). The antiviral diagram is our aid.

blocks.text: Viral infections ka ilaaj bacterial infections ke ilaaj se fundamentally (jar se hi) mukhtalif hai. Bacteria independent organisms (apne aap zinda rehne wale jaandaar) hain, jab ke viruses parasites (doosron par palne wale) hain. Bacteria khud zinda jaandaar hain, lekin viruses sahi maanon mein zinda nahi hote. Viruses hamare cells ke andar rehte hain aur apni copies banane (replicate) ke liye hamari apni DNA/RNA machinery (cell ka copy banane wala nizam) istemal karte hain. Is liye aisi dawa banana mushkil hai jo virus ko maare magar hamare sehatmand cells ko nuqsan na de.

blocks.title: Mutation
blocks.text: Viruses apna genetic material (genes wala material) bohat jaldi badal sakte hain. Isay mutation kehte hain.
Jo dawa aik saal kisi virus ke khilaf kaam karti hai, woh agle saal shayad kaam na kare, kyunke virus badal chuka hota hai. Isi liye flu ki vaccines har saal update karni parti hain.

Viruses hamare genome (cell ke poore genetic material) mein shamil ho kar saalon tak soye hue (inactive) reh sakte hain. Aaj kal ki dawaiyan sirf active viruses ko maar sakti hain, un ko nahi jo saalon se soye hue hain.

Antiviral dawaiyan viral life cycle (virus ki zindagi ke chakkar) ki kisi khaas stage (marhale) ko target karti (nishana banati) hain. Maslan kuch antivirals virus ko hamare cells mein dakhil hone se rokti hain, aur kuch virus ko apna genetic material copy karne se rokti hain. Antiviral dawaiyon ka sab se aam mechanism (tareeqa) enzyme inhibition (enzyme ko kaam se rokna) hai. Maslan protease inhibitor virus ke protease enzyme ko rokta hai, jo virus ki lambi protein strand (lari) ko kaam ke proteins mein kaat'ta hai. Yeh inhibitors HIV aur hepatitis C ke ilaaj mein bhi madad dete hain. Kuch antiviral dawaiyan jism ka immune response (bimari se larne wala jawab) enhance (mazboot) karti hain. Interferons aise proteins hain jo immune system ko viruses se larne ke liye boost (taqat) dete hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke protease inhibitor “virus ko apna protein aik lambi lari mein banane nahi deta”. Asal mein virus apne proteins aik lambi lari (polyprotein) ki shakal mein hi banata hai, aur us ka protease enzyme is lari ko kaam ke proteins mein kaat'ta hai. Protease inhibitor yeh kaatna rokta hai, is liye naye viruses mukammal nahi ban paate.

blocks.alt: Chaar qadam baen se daen: virus cell mein dakhil, genetic material ki copy, lambi protein lari protease se kat'ti, naye viruses bahar. Pehle teen qadmon ke neeche surkh X ke saath dawaon ke khane: entry blockers, copying blockers, protease inhibitors.
blocks.caption: Antiviral dawaiyan virus ki life cycle ke kis step (qadam) par asar karti hain (hamari drawing; kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Baen se daen virus ki life cycle ke chaar steps hain: cell mein dakhil hona, genetic material ki copy, lambi protein strand ka kat kar kaam ke proteins banna, aur naye viruses ka bahar aana. Neeche surkh X wale khane batate hain ke kaun si dawa kis step ko rokti hai: entry blockers pehla, copying blockers doosra aur protease inhibitors teesra step.

blocks.prompt: a) Drug A ka TI 3 aur Drug B ka TI 50 hai. Kaun si dawa zyada mehfooz hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Drug B. Is ki toxic (zehreeli) dose effective (faida dene wali) dose se 50 guna hai, jab ke Drug A mein sirf 3 guna; is liye B mein safety margin (hifazat ki gunjaish) kaheen zyada hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Antacids (maslan magnesium hydroxide, Mg(OH)₂) maide ka pH kaise control karte hain? Neutralization ki saada equation likhein.
blocks.explanation: Antacid base hai; yeh maide ke zyada HCl ko neutralize kar ke pH barha deta hai: Mg(OH)₂ + 2HCl → MgCl₂ + 2H₂O.

blocks.prompt: c) Penicillin mein woh core (markazi), strained (tani hui) heterocyclic ring system pehchanein jo is ke antibacterial asar ke liye zaroori hai.
blocks.explanation: Four-membered beta-lactam ring (jo thiazolidine ring se juri hai).

blocks.prompt: d) Morphine aur codeine (methylmorphine) ke chemical structures compare karein. Yeh chhota sa farq codeine ke prodrug hone se kaise jura hai?
blocks.explanation: Codeine woh morphine hai jis ka aik phenolic OH group OCH₃ mein badla hua hai. Is wajah se codeine opioid receptors se kamzor jurti hai; liver (jigar) mein codeine ka methyl group hat kar woh morphine ban jaati hai, aur zyada tar dard yahi morphine door karti hai. Is liye codeine prodrug (jism ke andar asal dawa mein badalne wali dawa) hai.

rows: Usi jagah –OCH₃ group (–OH ka H methyl se badla hua)
Opioid receptors se mazbooti se jurti hai
Prodrug hai: liver mein –CH₃ hat kar morphine banti hai, wahi zyada dard door karti hai

blocks.prompt: e) Bohat si antiviral dawaiyan mareez ke liye zyada side effects kyun deti hain?
blocks.explanation: Virus host (mareez) ke apne cells ki machinery se copies banata hai, is liye virus ko rokne wali dawa mareez ke sehatmand cells ke kaam mein bhi interfere (dakhal) kar sakti hai.

items: Viruses hamare cells ke andar reh kar hamari DNA/RNA machinery use karte hain.
Mutation: virus jaldi badalta hai, is liye flu vaccine har saal nayi.
Soye hue viruses par aaj ki dawaiyan asar nahi karti.
Antivirals: dakhla rokna, copy rokna, enzyme inhibition (protease inhibitors); interferons immunity barhate hain.
